race.title: Midnite Built Different Handicap
race.verdict: Dual C&D winner ELYAM maintained his 100% record for Michael Herrington and found further progress to boot when bringing up the hat-trick in determined style at Newcastle 4 weeks ago. A low-mileage 4-y-o, he firmly appeals as the type to rate higher still and is selected to defy the handicapper again. Ancient State has been a fine advert for the Adam Kirby yard this year and is feared, whilst a pace duel could well bring admirable veteran Baldomero into contention late in the piece. ELYAM ANCIENT STATE (IRE) BALDOMERO (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Elyam (11/10), Rhythm N Hooves (5/2), Ancient State (5/1), Baldomero (12/1), Dazzling Haze (14/1), Jack The Bachelor (16/1)
